choice: the instruction decides: a comment link (URL or comment:<id>) is a review-fix, anything else a CI log
why: the dispatcher writes a verdict link for REVISE fixes and the CI log for red CI; evidence.ci can be set on both, so it cannot pick

choice: findings and Max's go/answers are inlined in a fence longer than any backtick run (common.fenced, shared with Job data)
why: the brief keeps job text as data; a hostile backtick run cannot close the fence (test_quoted_text_stays_inside_a_fence)

choice: retry_comment present: Max's retry, linked; else T6: ended without a valid handoff (failed, stopped or past wall-clock)
why: the job row stores no failure reason; T6 retries exactly the jobs that finished without a handoff. A precise reason needs the dispatcher to copy job_events into the retry detail (left open)

choice: comment_url builds https://github.com/<repo>/pull/<pr>#issuecomment-<id> from an id or comment:<id>, else the line omits it
why: AC: no bare comment ids in the brief prose; Job data stays the raw row

choice: every build and fix variant has a numbered step: fetch, then rebase with --force-with-lease or merge
why: ticket: every builder variant brings the base in before ready; merge-only already is that step

choice: clone into the subfolder repo, then cd repo
why: #129's start writes .orch-worker.pid into $ORCH_JOB_WORKDIR, so the old 'empty at the start' line was false and gh repo clone into . fails (seen on this run's own job folder)

choice: rerun once with gh run rerun --failed, skip the base and push steps, ready at the same head
why: the ticket's rule; bringing the base in would change the head

choice: the fix variant comes from the instruction the fix started from, never the resume trigger: an extra-round go carries the capping REVISE verdict as its instruction, and an answers resume reads prior_instruction, which walks back through earlier answers resumes
why: Codex round 1: an extra round rendered a CI-fix and an answered CI-fix rendered a review-fix at the answers URL. Five dispatcher-to-render tests in test_brief_variants cover extra round, answered extra round, answered review-fix, answered and twice-answered CI-fix
